title: ECO-GANESHA WORKSHOP
summary: As part of our continued commitment towards environmental awareness, the workshop focused on encouraging students to celebrate Ganeshotsav in an eco-friendly and sustainable manner.
description:
As part of our continued commitment towards environmental awareness, the workshop focused on encouraging students to celebrate Ganeshotsav in an eco-friendly and sustainable manner.

Project Lead : Mrs Sonali Thakrar

The workshop was conducted by trainers from NGO LCCWA, who guided and taught the students how to make their very own Ganesha idols using natural clay. The hands-on experience was both educational and enjoyable, with the students participating enthusiastically and showcasing their creativity.

This meaningful initiative, which we have been passionately conducting for almost 20 years, aims to sensitise young minds and inspire them to become responsible citizens and ambassadors of environmental conservation.

A heartfelt thank you to the trainers from LCCWA, the school management, teachers, students and Mrs Davina Bali, Mrs Kiran Talreja, Rtn Mrs Ruchi Srivastava and Director Youth Service Rtn Smita Madgavkar for their valuable support in making this workshop a success.
location: English High School, Powai., Mumbai, Maharashtra
